Note: The Karachi-Rohri trunk: virtually every long-distance passenger service and the great majority of freight (Karachi division loads 63 percent of wagons, moving up-country) traverse it. Tiers are service-intensity CLASSES, not measurements; weight = tier x corridor km, normalised.
Rohri-Lahore trunk; the same spine minus traffic terminating south.
Lahore-Peshawar: dense passenger service; freight thins north of Lahore.
The Indus west-bank line: minimal through passenger service; occasional freight relief routing.
Rohri-Quetta: a handful of daily passenger pairs over hard grades; oil and general freight to Balochistan (Quetta division loads under 1 percent).
The Khanewal-Faisalabad-Lahore alternative routing carries several daily through services and industrial freight.
Every active network segment not on a defined corridor: residual local workings at the lowest tier.
